fusions.name: Trampling Front
fusions.desc: Tramples every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage and drives them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Lowered Horns
fusions.desc: A gore that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or elite it deals a further 5% of the target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Drover's Pace
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 12% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gathering Stampede
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover raises your physical damage by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
